'''Goliath My first deck Ever''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Goliath]]
* '''Published:''' 6 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' My first deck Ever


== Introduction ==

This is my very first deck Strategy tips and very welcome

== Strategy ==

I'm not sure about strategy yet.  Haven't played enough.  A few things I noticed was that the battle cards and stacking characters are important.  Getting the big guns out in space and ground also seem to help.  Would appreciate ratings and critiques immensly
